//: Minds (09 §3.1), plain and generic, written as a modder would. Each says in its `doc` how a character of its kind behaves, so that a player can learn it and rely on it (09 §1). Stances come from tags a character presents and from what it was seen to do, until relations are built. A percept makes them think at once only when it is very clear (`wake_clarity` 50: footsteps within two metres); anything they remember, anyone they come to see or lose, always does.
doc: An ordinary person. Keeps its routine where routines are loaded (`townsfolk_day`): home, work, the market at noon now and then, home, bed; and otherwise goes about near home, walking a little and standing a while. Goes to look at a noise it heard and did not see, then goes back to what it was doing. Calls out for help and runs from danger seen or heard close by. Keeps away from anyone it saw strike someone without cause, or who struck it, and shouts for the watch (`social/offences.json`: its caution outweighs its duty); keeps away too from anyone it hears of so. Opens doors on its way.

A watchman. Walks a beat near his post. Goes to look at a noise he heard and did not see. Goes for anyone he holds hostile while he can see them, and for anyone he saw hurt someone; once he has lost them, searches the house he lost them in, opening what a person could hide in (`search_hiding_places`, in `searching.json`), or else goes to where he last believed they were and looks round; and goes back to his beat.
A dog. Wanders near home and lies about. Goes to sniff at a noise it heard. Runs from anyone who hurt someone in front of it, and from what it fears.
